title: The 3 a.m. Notification That Gave Kavak Its First Sale
conflicts: The founder's origin story differs between interviews (scam when selling his car; six-month wait to sell it; used car in Mexico with mechanical problems; a later version with vanished money and an illegal car). The story says plainly that he has told it differently and keeps only the shared elements. Founding month: June 2016 (Revista Mercado) vs October 2016 (Forbes, El CEO): October used.
notes: Founder quotations exist only in Spanish, so they are given as reported speech. The first-sale scene rests on García Ottati's own account (Forbes Perú 2021). Later strain is mentioned (2022 restructuring and service complaints, Bloomberg Línea); El CEO's 2026 investigation into cars sold with irregular invoices is recorded in research_notes but not stated in the story, as it is a press finding, not a court or regulator's.
